# Gateway

Set up policies to inspect DNS, Network, HTTP, and Egress traffic

> Links below point directly to Markdown versions of pages or to a more detailed `llms.txt` index for a section. Any page can also be retrieved as Markdown by sending an `Accept: text/markdown` header to the page's URL without the `index.md` suffix (for example, `curl -H "Accept: text/markdown" https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-policies/`).
>
> For other Cloudflare products, see the [Cloudflare documentation directory](https://developers.cloudflare.com/llms.txt).

## Overview

- [Traffic policies](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-policies/index.md): Filter DNS, network, and HTTP traffic with Cloudflare Gateway traffic policies.

## Get started

- [Get started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-policies/get-started/index.md): Best practices for deploying Cloudflare Gateway traffic policies in phases.
- [DNS filtering documentation](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-policies/get-started/dns/llms.txt): Secure Web Gateway allows you to inspect DNS traffic and control which websites users can visit.
- [Network filtering](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-policies/get-started/network/index.md): Network filtering in Gateway.
- [HTTP filtering](https://developers.cloudflare.com/cloudflare-one/traffic-policies/get-started/http/index.md): HTTP filtering in Gateway.
